title: Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Eastmere Borough Council

headings.text: Minutes of the Ordinary Meeting of Eastmere Borough Council
48. Questions from members of the public

key_sentences: Councillor Brandt declared a non-pecuniary interest in item 49 as a member of the Eastmere Allotment Society.
RESOLVED that the minutes of the meeting held on 10 September 2026 be approved as a correct record and signed by the Mayor.
Mrs G. Pellow asked when the pedestrian crossing on Mill Lane would be repaired, and the Cabinet Member for Highways replied that the work was scheduled for the week beginning 19 October.
The Council considered the report of the Head of Parks and Open Spaces proposing an increase in allotment rents of 4.5 per cent.
Members noted that the waiting list for allotments stood at 214 households.
The next ordinary meeting of the Council will be held on Thursday 12 November 2026 at 7.00 pm.

list_items.text: The Mayor thanked the volunteers who supported the Heritage Open Days weekend, which attracted over 3,100 visitors.
The refurbished Wharf Street library will reopen on 2 November 2026.
The Remembrance Sunday parade will assemble at 10.15 am at the War Memorial.
(a) the allotment rents for 2027–28 be approved as set out in Table A;
(b) the concession rate of 50 per cent for residents in receipt of pension credit be retained.
